answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 38165 Country: India Title: We live in our bungalow. 10 years ago some one did black magic. There was one pot and 3 lemon, 3 haldi, half kaddu with needles in it. All was in pot (kundi) Question: We live in our bungalow. 10 years ago some one did black magic. There was one pot and 3 lemon, 3 haldi, half kaddu with needles in it. All was in pot (kundi). And there are lots of quarrels in house even for small points. We are also facing problem in arranging marriage for my sister. We have other home too, near to our current home. My family is thinking to shift to that house. We know that all is written in fate and everything will happen on its time but currently we are in very confusion. Also we doubt that there is some thing black magic in foundation of home too. Please suggest us what to do. My family is really in big trouble. We are 5 members, 2 brothers and 1 sister. Answer ID: 38165 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 803/803/M=1433) Do not doubt about any particular person without any proof. If the present house is not suitable for you then you may shift in other house, there is no harm in doing so. But you should have firm belief in fate. Also recite the holy Quran daily in your house and read Surah Falaq, Surah Naas and Ayatul Kursi and blow it. May Almighty Allah remove your problems! (Amen) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
